snippet.title: TMNT: Splintered Fate -Slash DLC Trailer
snippet.description: Everyone’s favorite lovable, well-cultured, yet famously short-tempered Turtle has finally arrived! Slash is officially joining the playable character roster, bringing the total number of heroes to eight. Towering over both friends and foes, Slash uses his massive claws and sheer physical strength to pulverize anyone standing in his way, being a true force of nature on the battlefield.
